description: This file defines an Android activity called AdsCatalogActivity that displays different ad layouts using fragments. It includes nested classes for a pager adapter and fragments, manages ad view lifecycles, and implements ad event callbacks. The code integrates the AdMob ad network SDK and demonstrates handling test mode and ad listener events.

classes.name: AdsCatalogActivity
classes.description: Main activity hosting a ViewPager with ad fragments.

classes.name: PagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter managing fragments for different ad layouts.

classes.name: AdFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying individual ad layouts with ad view and status handling.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specified page number.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes ad view, and loads ad request.

inner_classes.name: MyAdListener
inner_classes.description: Handles ad callback events such as ad received, failed, or screen changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up the ViewPager and adapter.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu options, particularly 'home' button to reset to the first page.
